description: intent=greeting or casual conversation; triggers=hi,hello,thanks,goodbye,small talk without a page request; behavior=reply briefly in context as the AppLab assistant; navigation=none required; this option is not a page or an executable action.

intent=user asks what AppLab is,what the application does or requests a general overview; app=demo web application with account authentication,profiles,user discovery,connections,personal todos,realtime global and direct chat,and public telemetry demonstration; behavior=briefly explain the application using only capabilities present in the available page descriptions; do not claim unsupported features or completed actions; navigation=mention a specific routable feature only when useful.

intent=user asks how AppLab is programmed,built,structured or which technologies,languages,libraries,database,APIs or communication methods it uses; frontend=Angular 21,TypeScript 5.9,Angular Material 21,Tailwind CSS 4,RxJS; backend=Java 21,Spring Boot 3.5,Spring Web REST APIs,Spring Data JPA,Spring Validation,Spring Security; database=MySQL; session_storage=Spring Session with Redis; realtime=Spring WebSocket with STOMP for chat messages,typing indicators,reactions and read updates; AI=Google GenAI Java SDK with Gemini,page selection followed by streamed assistant response over Server-Sent Events; email=Resend Java SDK; media=Thumbnailator backend image compression,browser-image-compression and ngx-image-cropper frontend processing; testing=Spring Boot Test and Vitest; behavior=answer only from these verified implementation facts,distinguish frontend from backend and do not invent deployment,hosting,cloud,CI/CD or unlisted technologies; navigation=none required unless user also requests an implemented page feature.

intent=authenticate existing account; required_fields=username or email,password; input_rules=no whitespace; password_controls=show/hide; form_feedback=inline validation,scroll to invalid input,loading indicator and disabled form during submission; links=Create account [[SIGNUP]],Forgot password [[EMAIL_ENTRY_FORGOT_PASSWORD]]; success=authenticated session,then supplied returnUrl or [[VIEW_PROFILE]].

intent=create account; required_fields=name,username,password,confirm password; ui_name=letters and spaces,max 30 characters,saved capitalized; ui_username=alphanumeric only,no spaces,3-20 characters,live availability check,saved lowercase; ui_password=6-20 characters,at least one letter and one number,no spaces; confirm_password=must match; password_controls=show/hide. optional_profile_photo=single image; desktop file picker,mobile Choose File or Camera; draggable/resizable square crop with fixed 1:1 aspect; Crop produces JPEG resized to width 500 with automatic compression; local preview,replace or remove before signup. submit=validation/loading feedback; success=account created and logged in,optional photo uploaded,automatic current-password verification,then [[EMAIL_ENTRY_SIGNUP]]; signup_email=optional subsequent step and can be skipped without losing account; supplied returnUrl preserved through flow; existing_account_link=[[LOGIN]].

intent=authorize adding or changing account email; purpose=CHANGE_EMAIL; requires=logged-in session; input=current password(required,no whitespace); controls=show/hide password,Verify and Continue with loading and validation feedback; Forgot password opens [[EMAIL_ENTRY_FORGOT_PASSWORD]]; success=authorize email change for current session for 1 hour,then [[EMAIL_ENTRY_EDIT_PROFILE]]; supplied returnUrl preserved; invalid purpose opens [[NOT_FOUND]]; incorrect password produces error feedback.

intent=add optional email after signup; purpose=SIGNUP; requires=logged-in account and password verification established by signup flow; input=email(required to send OTP),valid format,no spaces,trimmed and lowercase,unique across accounts; Send OTP=send verification code and open [[OTP_VERIFICATION_SIGNUP]] with requestId,destination email and server OTP metadata; Skip for now=continue to supplied returnUrl or [[VIEW_PROFILE]]; account already exists if email is skipped; email may be added later from [[EDIT_PROFILE]]; email ownership is confirmed only through OTP verification.

intent=add or replace account email; purpose=EDIT_PROFILE; prerequisite=logged-in session authorized through [[PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_CHANGE_EMAIL]]; input=new email(required),valid format,no spaces,trimmed and lowercase,unique across accounts,different from current email; Send OTP=sends verification code to new email and opens [[OTP_VERIFICATION_EDIT_PROFILE]] with requestId,destination email and server OTP metadata; current_email=changes only after successful OTP verification; supplied returnUrl preserved in flow; skip_control=unavailable.

intent=start password recovery; purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; guest_input=registered account email(required),valid format,no spaces,trimmed and lowercase; logged_in_with_email=own email prefilled and readonly; logged_in_without_email=No email linked notice,reset request form unavailable; Send OTP=send recovery code to matching registered email and open [[OTP_VERIFICATION_FORGOT_PASSWORD]] with requestId,destination email and server OTP metadata; supplied returnUrl preserved; skip_control=unavailable.

intent=verify optional signup email; purpose=SIGNUP; prerequisite=OTP request from [[EMAIL_ENTRY_SIGNUP]] and logged-in session; required_context=requestId; input=numeric OTP with server-defined length(currently 6 digits); display=destination email,send status,expiry countdown in minutes/seconds,resend cooldown in seconds,remaining resends; current_server_limits=OTP valid 10 minutes,resend cooldown 60 seconds,maximum 3 resends. controls=Verify OTP,Resend OTP,Skip email verification for now; resend=disabled during cooldown or after resends exhausted,clears OTP input and refreshes OTP metadata; successful_verification=saves verified email,then supplied returnUrl or [[VIEW_PROFILE]]; skip=continue without verifying email to supplied returnUrl or [[VIEW_PROFILE]]; missing purpose/requestId opens [[NOT_FOUND]]; incorrect/expired OTP produces error feedback.

intent=verify new account email; purpose=EDIT_PROFILE; prerequisite=OTP request from [[EMAIL_ENTRY_EDIT_PROFILE]] and original logged-in session; required_context=requestId; input=numeric OTP with server-defined length(currently 6 digits); display=destination email,send status,expiry countdown in minutes/seconds,resend cooldown in seconds,remaining resends; current_server_limits=OTP valid 10 minutes,resend cooldown 60 seconds,maximum 3 resends. controls=Verify OTP,Resend OTP; resend=disabled during cooldown or after resends exhausted,clears OTP input and refreshes OTP metadata; successful_verification=replace account email,then [[EDIT_PROFILE]]; skip_control=unavailable; missing purpose/requestId opens [[NOT_FOUND]]; incorrect/expired OTP produces error feedback.

intent=verify password-recovery OTP; purpose=FORGOT_PASSWORD; prerequisite=OTP request from [[EMAIL_ENTRY_FORGOT_PASSWORD]]; required_context=requestId; input=numeric OTP with server-defined length(currently 6 digits); display=destination email,send status,expiry countdown in minutes/seconds,resend cooldown in seconds,remaining resends; current_server_limits=OTP valid 10 minutes,resend cooldown 60 seconds,maximum 3 resends,maximum 5 incorrect attempts. controls=Verify OTP,Resend OTP; resend=disabled during cooldown or after resends exhausted,clears OTP input and refreshes OTP metadata; successful_verification=issue resetToken valid 10 minutes,then [[RESET_PASSWORD]]; skip_control=unavailable; missing purpose/requestId opens [[NOT_FOUND]]; incorrect/expired OTP produces error feedback.

intent=set new password after recovery verification; prerequisite=[[OTP_VERIFICATION_FORGOT_PASSWORD]]; required_context=valid resetToken; required_fields=new password,confirm password; ui_password=6-100 characters,at least one letter and one number,no spaces; confirmation=must match; controls=show/hide password,Reset Password; display=reset-token expiry countdown in minutes/seconds; reset_token=valid 10 minutes,single use; success=password changed,then [[LOGIN]] with supplied returnUrl preserved; missing resetToken opens [[NOT_FOUND]]; invalid/expired token produces error feedback.

scope=own logged-in account; display=profile photo or initials,name,bio when present,user ID,username,own email or No email added,Created and Updated date/time,public profile share link. photo=click to enlarge,close using close button or backdrop; link_controls=copy public profile link to clipboard,browser-native share with unsupported notice if unavailable. page_actions=Edit profile [[EDIT_PROFILE]],Add Email when absent [[PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_CHANGE_EMAIL]],Logout with Logout/Cancel confirmation. Connections button=opens own connection dialog; ui_status_tabs=Connections(accepted),Pending Requests,Rejected Requests; list_fields=photo/name,username,connection Created date/time,status action; photo opens viewer,person opens [[PUBLIC_PROFILE]] for username; infinite_scroll=20 connections per request; fixed_order=updatedAt descending; no connection search or manual sort control. connection_actions=incoming pending:Accept/Reject; outgoing pending:Cancel Request; accepted:Remove Connection; rejected outgoing:Resend Request; rejected incoming:Accept Request; action availability follows current relationship state.

scope=edit own logged-in account; sections=Profile Photo,Profile Basics,Credentials,Email; Back opens [[VIEW_PROFILE]]. Profile_Basics=name(required,letters and spaces,max 30 characters,saved capitalized),bio(optional,max 80 characters); Save Basic Info saves this section. Credentials=username(optional,alphanumeric only,no spaces,3-20 characters,live availability check,current username recognized,saved lowercase),current password(required),new password(optional,6-20 characters,at least one letter and one number,no spaces),confirm password(required when new password supplied,must match); Save Credentials saves this section; all password fields support show/hide; Forgot password opens [[EMAIL_ENTRY_FORGOT_PASSWORD]]; successful saves show feedback and clear password fields. Profile_Photo=Upload Photo/Edit Photo,Remove Photo with confirmation; single-image desktop file picker or mobile Choose File/Camera; draggable/resizable square crop,fixed 1:1 aspect,JPEG resized to width 500 with automatic compression; Save uploads photo independently of profile/credential forms. Email=display current email or No email added; Add Email/Change Email opens [[PASSWORD_VERIFICATION_CHANGE_EMAIL]],then new email entry and OTP verification; email not changed by Save Basic Info or Save Credentials.

scope=public directory of registered users; search=case-insensitive partial match in name OR username,updates after 500ms,matching text highlighted; ui_sort=Joined date(createdAt),ascending(oldest first) or descending(newest first),default descending; pagination=infinite scroll,10 users per request; search/sort changes reload results. user_card=profile photo or initials,name,username,Joined date,View profile button; photo opens enlarged full image viewer with close/backdrop dismissal; View profile opens [[PUBLIC_PROFILE]] for selected username; empty_state=No users found. ui_filters=no separate filters; ui_sort_fields=Joined date only; backend_only_sort=updatedAt,name,username also API-supported but absent from page controls.

scope=public profile for route username; username required; own username redirects to [[VIEW_PROFILE]]; unresolved username shows Profile unavailable. display=profile photo or initials,name,bio when present,user ID,username,Created and Updated date/time,public share link; email=only visible to owner; photo opens enlarged image viewer with close/backdrop dismissal; share_controls=copy link to clipboard,browser-native share with unsupported notice if unavailable. Connections button=accepted connections only for another user's profile; rows=photo/name,username,Created date/time,link to [[PUBLIC_PROFILE]] for each username; infinite_scroll=20 per request; fixed_order=updatedAt descending; no search/manual sort/status tabs for another user's connections. logged_in_other_user_actions=Chat opens [[USER_CHAT]] for this username,Connect sends request; guest Chat/Connect prompts [[LOGIN]] or [[SIGNUP]]. connection_states=none/canceled:Connect; outgoing pending:Pending menu > Cancel Request; incoming pending:Respond to Request > Accept/Reject; accepted:Connected > Remove Connection; rejected outgoing:Rejected > Resend Request; rejected incoming:You Rejected > Accept Request.

scope=current logged-in user's personal tasks; display=task cards with title,description,completion checkbox,Created timestamp,Updated timestamp; completed_indicator=checked checkbox and pale-green card. create=Create New Todo opens Add New Task dialog; fields=title(required,max 50 characters),description(required,multiline,max 255 characters); Add Task creates an incomplete task. edit=card three-dot menu > Edit opens prefilled Edit Task dialog; editable=title,description; Update Task saves. completion=checkbox toggles completed/incomplete and is disabled during save; success notification indicates new status. delete=card menu > Delete opens confirmation; Delete removes task,Cancel retains task. search=Search Todo; case-insensitive substring in title OR description; 500ms debounce; matches highlighted in both fields. ui_filter=Filter by Status:All(default),Completed,Incomplete; combines with search and sort. ui_sort=Created(createdAt) or Updated(updatedAt); ascending=oldest first,descending=newest first; default=Updated descending; clicking active sort toggles direction,switching field starts descending. pagination=6 tasks per page; Show More appends next page. search/filter/sort changes reload first page; create/edit/delete success refreshes list with cleared search,All status,Updated descending. backend_only_sort=title is API-supported but has no page control. task_details=read directly on cards; no standalone task detail page.
